run_test_performance_training: run the performance training script to train a BERT model on the GLUE MRPC dataset with configurable epochs
create_dataloaders_glue: create train and eval DataLoaders for the GLUE MRPC dataset with tokenization and collation
test_training_function: test the training function with configurable learning rate, batch size, epochs, and seed
review_training_performance: review the training performance by tracking accuracy across epochs and validating against a lower bound
build_model_sequence_classification: build a sequence classification model with Accelerator, optimizer, and linear decay scheduler for distributed training
